basis: Skeletal and dental anomalies define CCD2; developmental delay occurs in 3/6 (50%); hearing impairment in 2/7 (~29%) meets the approximate 30% boundary.

decisions.otologic: involved: hearing impairment in 2/7 (~29%) is approximately 30%; the small sample does not justify a strict numerical exclusion.

basis: Defined by intestinal mucosal inflammation; inflammation alone does not establish infection, autoimmunity or another immune-mediated etiology.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: the umbrella establishes intestinal inflammation, without establishing an infectious or immune-mediated cause across the group.

basis: Severe hypertension with defining advanced retinal microangiopathy; direct renal microvascular injury occurs in approximately 30-60%.

decisions.ocular: primary: advanced hypertensive retinopathy is a classic defining diagnostic criterion of malignant hypertension.

basis: Severe persistent neutrophil deficiency affects blood cells and constitutes quantitative innate immunodeficiency; secondary infections add no organ labels.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: severe chronic neutrophil deficiency directly impairs innate immunity; an immunodeficiency need not have autoimmune causation.

basis: Brain malformation defines the group; muscular dystrophy and structural ocular disease commonly accompany classic forms, estimated >30% each; isolated cerebral forms occur.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: muscular dystrophy commonly accompanies classic cobblestone syndromes, estimated above 30% across the group; absence in some forms does not exclude it.

basis: Chronic inflammation affects orbital tissues; the supplied umbrella does not establish an infectious or immune-mediated etiology.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: orbital inflammation alone does not establish infection or immune-mediated disease; an idiopathic immune-mediated subtype cannot define the whole umbrella.

basis: Skeletal myopathy and cardiomyopathy define the syndrome (5/5 each); myopathic ptosis in 5/5 represents persistent eyelid dysfunction. Motor delay reflects muscle weakness.

decisions.ocular: involved: ptosis in 5/5 reflects direct myopathic loss of eyelid function; eyelids fall within the ocular axis, even when the mechanism is muscular.

basis: Mycobacterial infection predominantly located in the lungs across this umbrella; drug resistance changes treatment susceptibility rather than organ distribution.

decisions.pulmonary: primary: the lungs are the usual site of tuberculosis across the group; drug resistance does not change that principal disease location.

basis: Posterior corneal ectasia and opacity define the disorder; associated skeletal and developmental abnormalities have unspecified frequencies and no established diagnostic status.

decisions.neurologic: none: developmental delay is reported without frequency; neither occurrence in approximately 30% nor status as a major diagnostic criterion is established.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: reported skeletal anomalies lack frequencies or established major diagnostic status sufficient to label this entire concept.

basis: Type I interferonopathy causing inflammatory encephalopathy; chilblains occur in ~40% of AGS overall, but that frequency is not established for this dominant TREX1 subtype.

decisions.dermatologic: none: the approximately 40% chilblain frequency in AGS overall cannot reliably establish at least approximately 30% in this specific dominant TREX1 subtype.
